name: Cell and Molecular Biology PhD
institution: The University of Texas at Austin

english.note: Program IELTS range6.5–7.0; safer7 retained. Central DET115 accepted, but program instructions mention only TOEFL/IELTS; confirm DET. US/qualifying-country bachelor exemption.

applicationFee.note: $65 US;$90 international. Need-based waiver only US citizens/PR pursuing first graduate degree.

documents: Two separate purpose essays (recommended one page each): future goals; research/faculty interests
Official transcripts from every prior college/university; translation if needed
requirements.note: Research/faculty-interest essay up to5 faculty. Initial application at least3days early recommended. Three first-semester rotations before advisor selection.

funding.note: Undated published stipend $40,000/year ($3,333/month), in-state tuition and access to insurance; ISSS fee for internationals. Program first semester, then permanent lab; continued funding depends on standing and funds. At least one semester TA.
